title: बालविकास केन्द्रले शिक्षण सिकाइमा पारेको प्रभाव {Impact of Child Development Center on Teaching and Learning}
nepali: वालविकास केन्द्रले सिकाई उपलब्धीमा पारेको प्रभाव नामक यस शोध पत्रमा वालविकास केन्द्र वाट कक्षा एकमा आएका वालवालिकाहरुको शैक्षिक उपलब्धी विश्लेषण गर्ने मूख्य उद्देश्य राखीएको छ । इन्द्रपुर स्रोत केन्द्र अन्तरगतका सामुदायिक विद्यालयमा संचालित ३८ वटा वालविकास केन्द्रमा शोध सिमित गरिएको छ ।  अध्ययनको तथ्याङ्क संकलन गर्ने क्रममा मोरङ जिल्लाको इन्द्रपुर स्रोत केन्द्र अन्तरगतका ३८ वटा वालविकास केन्द्रहरु मध्ये एगचउयकष्खभ क्बmउष्लिन का आधारमा ६ वटा वालविकास केन्द्रको छनौछ गरी गुणात्मक र वर्णनात्मक ढाँचामा यो अन्ययन सम्पन्न गरिएको छ । तथ्याङ्कको स्रोतको रुपमा प्राथमिक र द्वितीय दुवै तथ्याङ्कको प्रयोग गरिएको छ ।  वालविकास केन्द्रको अवसर नपाई सिधै विद्यालयमा भर्ना भएका वालवालिकाहको शैक्षिक उपलब्धी भन्दा वालविकास केन्द्रको अवसर प्राप्त गरी कक्षा एकमा भर्ना भएका वालवालिकाहरुको शैक्षिक उपलव्धी उच्च रहेको , विद्यालयमा नियमितता उच्च रहेको, अतिरिक्ति क्रियाकलापमा वढि सहभागिता हुने कुरा अध्ययनको मूख्य प्राप्ति रहेको छ ।  वालविकास केन्द्रको सकारात्मक संकेत वारे सम्वन्धित सरोकारवालाहरु लाई जानकारी गराउनु पर्ने, वालविकास संचालन भएका पछिका वर्षहरुमा देखिएका परिवर्तनको अभिलेख राख्नु पर्ने, वालविकास केन्द्रलाई सहयोग गर्ने व्यक्ति, संघ सस्थाहरुलाई उत्प्रेरित गर्दै सहयोग गर्ने दाताहरुलाई सम्मान पत्र, कदर पत्र दिई अरुलाई पनि सहयोग गर्न अभिप्रेरित गर्नु पर्ने, वालविकास केन्द्रमा काम गर्ने स.का.हरुलाई तालिमको व्यवस्था गर्ने र स.का. हरुको पारिश्रमिक ज्यादै न्यून भएको कारण ले समय अनुसार उचित व्यवस्था गर्नु पर्ने जस्ता पक्षहरु लाई मुख्य सुझावको रुपमा प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ ।
american_english:
This research paper, named "The Impact of the Child Development Center on Learning Achievement," has the main objective of analyzing the educational achievement of children who come into class one through the Child Development Center.
The research is limited to the 38 Child Development Centers operating in community schools under Indrapur Resource Center.
While collecting data for the study, among the 38 Child Development Centers under Indrapur Resource Center of Morang district, 6 Child Development Centers were selected on a [garbled OCR] basis, and this study was completed in a qualitative and descriptive format.
Both primary and secondary data have been used as sources of data.
The main attainment of the study is that the educational achievement of children who gained the opportunity of the Child Development Center and enrolled in class one is higher than the educational achievement of children who enrolled directly in school without getting the opportunity of the Child Development Center, that regularity in school is high, and that there is higher participation in extra activities.
It has been presented as the main suggestion that the concerned stakeholders should be informed about the positive indication of the Child Development Center, that records should be kept of the changes seen in the years after the operation of the Child Development Center, that persons and organizations helping the Child Development Center should be motivated by giving certificates of appreciation and letters of appreciation to donors who help, so as to encourage others to help too, that training should be arranged for the S.Kas working in the Child Development Center, and that, because the remuneration of the S.Kas is extremely low, appropriate arrangements should be made according to time.

australian_english:
This research paper, called "The Impact of the Child Development Centre on Learning Achievement," has as its main aim analysing the educational achievement of kids who come into class one through the Child Development Centre.
The research is limited to the 38 Child Development Centres running in community schools under Indrapur Resource Centre.
While gathering data for the study, out of the 38 Child Development Centres under Indrapur Resource Centre in Morang district, 6 Child Development Centres were picked on a [garbled OCR] basis, and the study was completed in a qualitative and descriptive format.
Both primary and secondary data were used as sources of data.
The main thing the study found is that kids who got the chance to go to a Child Development Centre and then enrolled in class one have higher educational achievement than kids who enrolled straight into school without that chance, that they attend school more regularly, and that they take part more in extra activities.
The main suggestions put forward are that the people concerned should be told about the positive signs from the Child Development Centre, that records should be kept of the changes seen in the years after the Child Development Centres started running, that individuals and organisations helping the centres should be motivated by giving certificates and letters of appreciation to donor helpers so others are encouraged to help too, that training should be arranged for the S.Kas working in the centres, and that, because the S.Kas are paid very little, proper arrangements should be made in line with the times.
informal_english: So this paper's called 'The Impact of the Child Development Center on Teaching and Learning.' The main aim was to look at how kids who come into class one through a Child Development Center go with their learning. The study was limited to the 38 CDCs running in community schools under Indrapur Resource Center. When they were gathering data, they picked 6 of those 38 centres on some [garbled OCR] basis and ran the study in a qualitative, descriptive way, using both primary and secondary data. The big finding: kids who got the CDC experience before class one did better academically, turned up to school more regularly, and joined in more extra activities than kids who went straight into school. The main suggestions: let the relevant people know about the positive signs coming from the CDCs, keep records of the changes seen in the years after the centres started running, motivate helpers and donors with certificates and letters of appreciation so others get keen to help, arrange training for the S.Kas working in the centres, and sort out their pay properly since it's way too low.
